name: Cougar Claws
summary: Across Mulgore’s central plains, tauren hunters gather Cougar Claws for a cleansing ritual. The claws come from flatland cougars, among the grasslands’ apex hunters.

sections.title: A Vessel of Natural Balance
sections.body: Flatland cougars rank among the apex hunters of Mulgore’s grasslands, stalking prey by instinct. For the tauren, taking their claws is neither casual slaughter nor trophy hunting; it gathers the beast’s natural spirit. When goblin operations defile the plains’ ancestral waters, Mull Thunderhorn asks young hunters to collect Cougar Claws alongside prairie stalker claws. The tauren believe native beasts’ pure predatory instincts can be woven into a ritual totem. They mean to use it to scour unnatural toxins and foul sorcery from the poisoned Thunderhorn Water Well.

faq.q: What are Cougar Claws used for?
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn uses Cougar Claws with stalker claws to craft the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem. The tauren weave the spirit of native predators into ritual objects to purify wells poisoned by goblin industry.

faq.q: Where do Cougar Claws come from?
faq.answer: Flatland cougars prowl Mulgore’s rolling plains, especially east and west of Bloodhoof Village, and provide Cougar Claws.

faq.q: Why does Mull Thunderhorn need predator claws to cleanse a well?
faq.answer: Tauren shamanic and druidic traditions honor the purity of wild beasts’ hunting. Native predators live in balance with the land, unlike goblins who exploit and defile it, so their essence can counter artificial corruption.

faq.q: Are Cougar Claws useful for anything else?
faq.answer: Beyond crafting the ritual totem for the Thunderhorn Water Well, Cougar Claws have no specialized use. They are typically sold to local traders.

angles.text: Gathering Cougar Claws teaches young tauren that hunting serves balance and spiritual need. That stands against the pollution caused by goblin enterprises.
As a shaman, you know local predators’ essence remains tied to the spirits of the plains. It can serve as a conduit for purifying wards and cleansing totems.
